body:
Adds a transport development collection with articulated wagon and carriage studies, a skinned horse, modular light harness and coupled idle/walk/trot previews. Consolidates #1046's named resident authoring using existing reconstructed 1835 identities Otis Bardwell, Joseph Dufresne and Martin Flynn. Appearance, workwear and actions remain declared reconstructions with pinned source/license records.

Repairs the defects exposed by actual validation: the expression reader now measures all skinned meshes when hair loads first and restores each mesh's exact defaults, including after failure. Authored web exports use medium Meshopt mode with 16-bit normals; pinned glTFTransform 4.5.0 high mode caps normals at eight bits, producing hair normal length error 0.005252806 against the unchanged 0.005 guard. The real exporter canary reproduces that failure and passes at 0.000002434 with the corrected mode. Generic fixture export and runtime tolerances are unchanged. Existing hierarchy import and raw-source normal corrections remain included.

Four repaired harness parts remove the original horse crossings. Actual original/repaired GLB controls distinguish 100 bind-pose crossings from zero and reject missing, renamed or orphaned parts. Against the full horse over 63 sampled idle/walk/trot poses, the four parts have zero proper crossings and minimum 5.113 mm separation. Other 32 harness parts and horse bytes are unchanged. Desktop/mobile views were inspected. These sampled surface checks do not establish continuous motion or solid containment.

Validation at **f97ee94970385d35f469c449c6b111b0d8488057**, including dev c7770e99:

- Full preflight PASS: 1,012 checks, zero failed, 377 intentional self-tests; changelog, ticket IDs and postcommit checks PASS. The 59-step owning derived tail converged in two passes, with the final pass changing nothing. The prior stale-generated-output failure is preserved.
- Exact remote smoke source audit PASS: 15 stages, 13 strict per-leg guards and required stage-14 style-library assertion.
- [Canonical human workflow](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago/actions/runs/39220530645) PASS: all 32 actual source/web fixtures, 24 published and 24 source resident inspections, six hierarchy/raw surface comparisons and 24 Khronos reports with zero errors/warnings. All published hair normals decode as Int16; maximum length error 0.000022319 stays below the unchanged 0.005 guard.
- Published desktop/mobile smoke matrix: all 18 legs dispatched at this exact head, required before merge. Final coverage will be checked from actual terminal logs.

Earlier failed canonical runs and the canceled obsolete smoke batch remain recorded in central evidence. Photographic quality, independent review of canonical CI images, period construction acceptance, production LODs, loaded tack/reins, traffic, mounted riders and accessible boarding/riding remain open. Artifact downloads remain blocked by the unapplied environment policy; numeric logs do not replace image review. Outside carriage/body/motion refinements are saved separately. This PR stays draft until final checks are green, then merges into dev.
